description: This file contains shell script functions related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for OpenWrt, including image validation, copying configs, bootloader upgrades, and managing disk partitions.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the image to be used for upgrade by checking its magic word and comparing partition layouts.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration to the appropriate partition.

methods.name: platform_do_bootloader_upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades the bootloader on the specified disk device, preparing for new bootloader installation.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Executes the main upgrade procedure, handling partition layout, image writing, UUID updates, and bootloader upgrades.
